Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Storm RAMIL
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 19 October 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales, Pampanga, Tarlac, Cavite, Batangas, Quezon, Laguna, Bulacan(Baliuag, Plaridel, Guiguinto, Bulakan, Malolos, Pulilan, Calumpit, Hagonoy, Paombong) and Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, San Isidro, Jaen, Zaragoza, San Antonio, Aliaga, Quezon, Licab, Guimba, Cuyapo, Nampicuan, Talugtug, Munoz, Santo Domingo, Lupao, Carranglan, San Jose, Pantabangan, Talavera).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila, Rizal, Nueva Ecija(Gapan, General Tinio, Bongabon, Cabanatuan, Gabaldon, General Mamerto Natividad, Laur, Llanera, Palayan, Penaranda, Rizal, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa) and Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Bocaue, Bustos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Marilao, Norzagaray, Obando, Pandi, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
